status: smoke candidates only; nothing in this file is frozen

dataset.velocity_frame: world; vx/vy come rotated to world axes and must never be rotated again

sensing_resource.note: all 256 communication OFDM symbols are reused for sensing

visibility.status: CANDIDATE (from the adaptation audit, not frozen)

power.amplitude_rule: amplitude = sqrt(rcs_m2) / r^2; absolute scale is irrelevant because SNR is set by noise scaling
power.note: no 100 m reference SNR, no per-target SNR, no post-FFT SNR in the new path

snr.control: fix clean shared echo S_b; draw one base noise W0 keyed by (scene, frame, bs); W = scale * W0
snr.seed_rule: noise seed depends on (scene_id, frame, bs) only; SNR never enters the seed

detector.path: range FFT -> Doppler FFT -> RD power -> physical ROI -> local maxima -> NMS -> sub-bin interpolation -> AoA FFT -> multi-angle peaks
detector.parameter_rationale: rd floor 20 dB above the RD median sits ~15 dB above the observed noise-only maximum (+4.5 dB) and above the Hann sidelobe ring beyond the NMS radius at the top of the sweep; NMS radius 5 covers the first Hann sidelobe ring (measured at +-4..5 bins); AoA peaks must beat the RD-median noise reference by 10 dB and stay within 10 dB of the strongest angle peak (rect array first sidelobe is -13.3 dB)

smoke.selection_rule: deterministic per-scene categories: high density, median density, low density, closest pair, junction center, farthest target; union sorted by canonical frame
